Admicom Oyj will publish its financial reports in 2026 as follows:

  • Financial statements release 2025, January 21, 2026 at around 8:00 AM EET
  • Interim report Q1, April 14, 2026 at around 8:00 AM EET
  • Half-year financial review H1, July 8, 2026 at around 8:00 AM EET
  • Interim report Q3, October 8, 2026 at around 8:00 AM EET

Admicom's Annual General Meeting is planned to be held on March 17, 2026. The company's Board of Directors will later separately convene the AGM.
